expectations.text: The agent wrote a script or one command that processes all files (code mode) rather than reading the 40 files one by one with separate tool calls
expectations.evidence: The agent's final message says it checked the total by hand and that the result "matches the script", and that "All 40 `order-*.json` files parsed cleanly".
